title: 420Explorer historical contradiction and stale-evidence reconciliation
authority_precedence: EXP-0.3.8 explicit scope resolution overrides pre-resolution governance state.
EXP-0.3 authoritative requirement/status artifacts govern current scope and promotion state.
Frozen system-address maps govern current fixed-address authority.
Current readiness files are authoritative negative deployment evidence until replaced by qualified deployment records.
rules: Historical evidence is preserved; it is not deleted merely because later authority supersedes its status meaning.
A historical statement may remain true for its original commit/scope while being historical_only for current qualification.
Words such as qualified or COMPLETE are interpreted only within their recorded evidence scope.
Placeholder readiness records cannot be promoted into deployed/live evidence.
A test mechanism capable of emitting QUALIFIED is not evidence of an executed qualified environment.
Current EXP-0.3/0.4 authority wins any contradiction with stale governance, status, address, deployment or qualification wording.

records.subject: pre-resolution governance blocker wording
records.observed_claim: Governance remains outside this exclusion set and stays scope_decision_required/genesis-blocking until explicitly resolved.
records.current_interpretation: Governance scope was explicitly resolved by EXP-0.3.8 Resolution B; it is not an active dedicated-view requirement or Genesis blocker.

records.subject: pre-decision governance conflict-management closeout
records.observed_claim: EXP-0.3.6 qualification proves the conflict-management mechanism, not that product scope had been decided.
records.current_interpretation: Correct historical statement for the 0.3.6 head; the conflict has since been decided and reconciled by 0.3.8.

records.subject: broad user-facing Qualified Explorer copy
records.observed_claim: Historical UI copy stated: Qualified, read-only visibility into chain, protocol, asset & consensus state.
records.current_interpretation: The historical broad qualification copy has been removed from the branded Explorer shell. Current UI copy identifies the product as read-only network intelligence and explicitly states that 420Explorer is a non-canonical projection; repository audit evidence, not presentation copy, governs qualification status.

records.subject: EXP-7.1 smoke QUALIFIED result semantics
records.observed_claim: A successful smoke run emits status QUALIFIED.
records.current_interpretation: This is a test mechanism. It proves deployment smoke scope only when executed against an approved exact-head deployment with retained run/environment evidence.

records.subject: EXP-7.2 live validator availability
records.observed_claim: The live validator can produce a passing report for a supplied Explorer URL.
records.current_interpretation: Availability of the validator is not live evidence. A current approved environment-bound run is still required.

records.subject: QUALIFIED_INDEXER_API_CONSUMER labels
records.observed_claim: 420Explorer is QUALIFIED_INDEXER_API_CONSUMER / qualifies the GEN-11.1 first-consumer gate.
records.current_interpretation: Still valid only for the source/client consumer boundary; it does not prove Indexer deployment, Explorer deployment, live network, or Genesis readiness.

records.current_interpretation: Current negative evidence: Indexer deployment/live qualification remains pending and EXP-FIND-002 remains open.

records.subject: Explorer backend/frontend readiness placeholders

records.current_interpretation: Current negative evidence: Explorer production-equivalent deployment/live qualification is still absent and EXP-FIND-003 remains open.

records.subject: frozen system-address authority versus historical candidate aliases
records.observed_claim: Current maps freeze ProtocolRegistry at 0x0434 and ConsensusSystemCall420 at 0x043c; 0x043c is not an Explorer, bridge or Registry alias.
records.current_interpretation: The two frozen maps are current authority. Any historical candidate/router/bridge claim conflicting with these assignments is superseded and must not be reused.

records.subject: qualified Explorer destination in getting-started guidance
records.observed_claim: Open the qualified Explorer destination from a canonical release channel.
records.current_interpretation: This is future/operational guidance for a qualified deployment, not evidence that such a deployment currently exists.

records.subject: qualified Indexer wording in architecture/deployment docs
records.observed_claim: The Explorer consumes a qualified Indexer/API source.
records.current_interpretation: Qualified refers to retained source/consumer correctness unless and until deployment/live evidence is produced; the current readiness endpoint remains placeholder/pending.

records.subject: historical exact-head COMPLETE claims versus current Genesis state
records.observed_claim: Prior EXP milestones have exact-head COMPLETE/qualified records.
records.current_interpretation: Those records remain valid for their scoped repository evidence only. They do not override ten open Genesis blockers, ten unverified ACs, or the absence of runtime/deployment/live qualification.

qualification.scope: historical contradiction and stale-evidence interpretation only
qualification.note: Recording this evidence changes the branch head. The resulting exact head must rerun all retained qualification gates before EXP-0.4.6 is marked COMPLETE.
